cat > /root/autodl-tmp/afford_invar/cleanup_old_checkpoints.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-cleanup: keep only the latest 2 merged checkpoints per run pattern
RUNS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/afford_invar/runs"

# Whitelist: skip these run directories entirely
WHITELIST="phase1_transfer_v3"

# Clean merged checkpoints (pattern: *--XXXX_chkpt)
for pattern in $(ls -d ${RUNS_DIR}/*--*_chkpt 2>/dev/null | sed 's/--[0-9]*_chkpt$//' | sort -u); do
    base=$(basename "$pattern")
    echo "$WHITELIST" | grep -qw "$base" && continue
    checkpoints=($(ls -d ${pattern}--*_chkpt 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k$(echo "${pattern}--" | tr '-' '\n' | wc -l) -n))
    num=${#checkpoints[@]}
    if [ $num -gt 2 ]; then
        for ((i=0; i<num-2; i++)); do
            echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') Removing: ${checkpoints[$i]}"
            rm -rf "${checkpoints[$i]}"
        done
    fi
done

# Clean internal checkpoint-N dirs (keep latest 2)
for run_dir in ${RUNS_DIR}/*/; do
    run_name=$(basename "$run_dir")
    echo "$WHITELIST" | grep -qw "$run_name" && continue
    checkpoints=($(ls -d "${run_dir}checkpoint-"* 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k2 -n))
    num=${#checkpoints[@]}
    if [ $num -gt 2 ]; then
        for ((i=0; i<num-2; i++)); do
            echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') Removing: ${checkpoints[$i]}"
            rm -rf "${checkpoints[$i]}"
        done
    fi
done
SCRIPT
